Because demand shifts sharply from week to week, the quantity of produce ordered each Monday is based largely _____ the dinner reservations already entered in the booking system.

Applicants for the two open sales positions must submit their reference letters _____ the company's hiring portal, since documents sent as e-mail attachments cannot be added to an application file.
Because the reinforced shelving distributes weight across the entire frame, records clerks can _____ stack archived file boxes three levels high.
Temporary workers listed with the staffing agency can be placed on short _____, since client companies frequently report an absence only a few hours before a shift begins.
